subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with selective reply routing split or handled by existing message-tool policy?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but model-selected channel routing is a delivery-policy/API decision that should not be bundled into a command prompt metadata repair by default.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep or open a separate product/API follow-up for channel-selective replies and require maintainer approval before changing delivery semantics.

options.title: Rely On Existing Routing Policy
options.body: Document that selective visible output belongs to message-tool/visible-reply policy and close the broader routing request after the prompt metadata gap is fixed.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` only.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and latest maintainer scope comment make this the clearest owner for the prompt-metadata versus delivery-policy decision.
